modelIntro.title: What Changed in Seedance 2.5
description: Seedance 2.5 gives longer, reference-rich ideas room to become complete scenes. Direct the action with images, video, audio, and text, or define the opening and ending with first and last frames.
Use it for character-led sequences, product stories, campaign concepts, and visual preproduction where timing, placement, and interaction shape the result.

featureStories.title: Key Features of Seedance 2.5
featureStories.description: Create longer scenes, combine a richer reference brief, choreograph motion across the frame, and control where the video begins and ends.

items.title: Build a Complete 30-Second Scene
paragraphs: Seedance 2.5 supports standard continuous video generation up to 30 seconds, twice the 15-second maximum of Seedance 2.0. A single scene can move from setup to payoff without being split into a stack of short outputs.

Use that longer canvas for story ads, product demonstrations, character performances, and previsualized camera moves. Write the brief as a sequence: establish the opening, describe what changes through the shot, and state where the action should land.

media.alt: A real Seedance generated video result shown in the Toolaze model page

items.title: Direct with Up to 50 Multimodal References
paragraphs: Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 50 multimodal reference inputs across text, images, video, and audio. Instead of flattening a detailed concept into one prompt, bring more of the original creative brief into the generation.

Toolaze currently provides up to 30 image uploads, 10 reference videos, and 10 audio clips. Give each source one clear job: establish identity and art direction with images, demonstrate movement with video, and guide voice, rhythm, or ambience with audio.

media.alt: Real Toolaze Seedance 2.5 controls for image, video, and audio references

items.title: Choreograph Motion, Space, and Interaction
paragraphs: Seedance 2.5 emphasizes motion paths, spatial positions, and interactions between subjects. Describe where an action begins, how it travels, where each subject belongs, and how one subject responds to another.

Write the shot like choreography: identify who moves, trace the route, name the destination, and define the relationship between subjects and their surroundings. Use @ mentions to connect each instruction to the right image, video, or audio reference.

media.alt: Real Toolaze reference video, reference audio, prompt, and mention controls

items.title: Control the Opening and Ending Frames
paragraphs: First and Last Frames mode lets you define the exact opening image and final composition. Seedance 2.5 generates the action and camera movement that connect those visual endpoints.

Use this path for cinematic transitions, product transformations, visual reveals, looping shots, and scene previsualization. Choose Multimodal mode when several image, video, and audio references need to direct the complete scene.

rows.label: Generation length
rows.baseline: Up to 30 seconds in a standard continuous generation.

rows.label: Reference capacity
rows.baseline: As many as 50 multimodal reference inputs in one generation.
rows.target: Up to 9 images, 3 video clips, and 3 audio clips alongside text instructions.

rows.label: Scene direction
rows.baseline: Describe detailed motion paths, spatial placement, subject interaction, and multi-beat camera movement.
rows.target: Guide composition, motion, camera language, visual effects, and sound within a shorter scene.

rows.label: Best fit
rows.baseline: Longer story sequences, product demonstrations, character performances, and source-heavy creative direction.

howToUse.title: How to Use Seedance 2.5 in Toolaze
howToUse.subtitle: Move from model selection to a polished first take in four clear steps.

steps.title: Select Seedance 2.5
steps.desc: Open Image to Video or Text to Video, choose Seedance 2.5, and select the generation path that matches the shot. Use First/Last Frames when the visual endpoints must stay fixed.

media.alt: Toolaze Seedance 2.5 model selector with Image to Video and Text to Video tabs

steps.title: Build the creative brief
steps.desc: Add the images, video, and audio that define the subject, style, movement, and sound. Write the scene in sequence, then use @ labels when an instruction belongs to one specific asset.

media.alt: Toolaze Seedance 2.5 image, reference video, reference audio, and prompt controls

steps.title: Choose the output settings
steps.desc: Set the duration, choose an adaptive or fixed aspect ratio, select MP4 or MOV, and pick 480p or 720p. Match the format to the publishing destination before generating the first take.

media.alt: Toolaze Seedance 2.5 aspect ratio, output format, resolution, and Generate Video controls

steps.title: Open History and compare takes
steps.desc: After the first generation, switch from Demo to History to compare previous takes, review their prompts and settings, and use Recreate on the version worth refining. Change only the prompt line or reference that caused the mismatch.

media.alt: Toolaze Demo and History tabs with History selected

faq.a: Yes. Enable Native Audio when you want Seedance 2.5 to create sound with the video, or add an audio reference when voice, music, ambience, rhythm, or a specific cue should shape the result.

faq.q: Can Toolaze export a Seedance 2.5 video in 4K?
faq.a: Toolaze currently exports Seedance 2.5 video in 480p or 720p. Choose 720p for the highest available output from this generator, then upscale the finished video separately if the delivery requires a larger frame.

faq.q: Can I edit one specific area of a generated video?
faq.a: Local region editing is not available inside the current Seedance 2.5 generator. Put critical details into the brief before generation, then use a dedicated video editor if the finished shot needs a precise correction in one area.
